title: Middle cardiac vein
summary: The middle cardiac vein commences at the apex of the heart; ascends in the posterior longitudinal sulcus, and ends in the coronary sinus near its right extremity.

sections.heading: Variation
paragraphs: The middle cardiac vein has a constant location on the surface of the ventricles.

sections.heading: Clinical significance
paragraphs: The middle cardiac vein is useful for epicardial access to the inferior side of the ventricles.
